payload.description:
Purpose: live development exercise must not fail because ComputerTurnJobs still holds a leftover from an interrupted run.

The exercise already checks job_id and turn_id. A single receive of the wrong message currently exits 1. Drain unmatched messages until the current resume job appears or the wait expires.

Not included: Fargate, staging/production, merge to main, changing queue topology.
payload.title: Named exercise drains stale computer-queue leftovers
